rules.statement: The order directing the administratrix to file an account does not estop her from denying that the petitioner is entitled to any share in the estate of the intestate when distribution takes place.
rules.supporting_quote: "That order of the 9th March, 1900, cannot be taken as estopping the administratrix or the heirs, when distribution of the estate takes place, from denying that the petitioner is entitled to any share in the estate of the intestate."
